## Checklist

- [ ] `cargo fmt --check`, `cargo clippy --all-targets --locked -- -D warnings`
      and `cargo test --locked` pass (in `app/`)
- [ ] New UI text goes through `tr()`/`trf()` and has a German entry in
      `app/i18n/de.po` (or I said below that I need help with it)
- [ ] UI changes: screenshot attached
- [ ] No new dependencies, or discussed in an issue first
- [ ] User-visible change: line in the `Unreleased` section of `CHANGELOG.md`

See [CONTRIBUTING.md](https://github.com/FreshKnoppers/Catwright/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md) for details.
